string.text: I've just seen $who, $where. I've heard that someone wants that stalker dead.
What's up with $who lately? Is it true that someone is after that stalker?
It seems $who has made some powerful enemies. That stalker should stop roaming around $where and get the fuck out of there before things get bad.
$who may not be among us for much longer - heard that someone's out to claim the bounty on that stalker.
There's a certain stalker around $where who should be very cautious. Heard some mercenaries are looking for an easy target to make profit off.
Hey, $who! Someone wants your head on a pike. If I were you, I would hide for a while and avoid pissing off the wrong kind of people.
If I were $who I wouldn't stick around $where, they say that death is coming soon.
We got an outsider. It's not clear, but I think it is $who.
Just saw some stalker... is that $who?
If that stalker tries something funny, we're gonna have a bad time around here.
Is that so? Let me know if you see that idiot heading this way.
If that retard tries to do something stupid, open fire at once.
They killed one of my friends the other day, fucking bastards.
You hear those growls in the distance? That's a bad sign, I swear it.
Eh, $name, my girl. You got some smokes?!
You know what? I should be the one leading you around. What the hell is a girl like you doing in the Zone?
Damn, what's that shitty smell? You should bathe some time, sis.
Girl, it's all the same. Bosses in here, bosses out there... always someone riding your ass.
Got any vodka, sis? You probably owe me...
I can't get that shitty tune out of my head! Just fucking shoot me, girl.
You probably think you're a real cool gal, eh $name? Let's see how the Zone treats you.
All those morons with their worthless gear and their worthless graphs - it's about the swag, gal.
Girl, I miss Spirit's cooking. He could fry up a great omelet.
I hope I can rely on you, $name. I'd take one good gal over ten punks.
What's your interest in the Zone, miss?
Got anything on you, sis?
Smell that fresh air, girl.
Free Zone, my girl. The Zone is a middle finger to humanity's bullshit.
Think meta, sis. That's what Loki told me.
Rigid things break under stress - you've got to be flexible, girl.
You seem like the kind of girl who would pull off some stunt to impress the boss. Don't do anything too stupid, ok?
An untrustworthy ally is worse than an enemy; pick your friends well, honey.
Girl, Sidorovich's prices are unbelievable.
It takes a strong mind to retain a sense of humor in the Zone.
Sister, show no mercy to those who stand against the Monolith's will.
Be careful sister, the enemy may show up at any moment.
Trust no one who doesn't wears the colors of the Monolith, sister. We are alone in this world.
Be careful around here, this is no place for a girl like you. Maybe not even a place for a guy like me either.
Free stalkers used to own the abandoned factory. A man named Orest was who coordinated them, old times, girl.
Hey, wanna have a drink at 100 Rads, babe?
Hey, you crazed bitch! Is visiting this place your greatest idea?!
Shit, shit, shit... what are we doing here?
I hope you know what you're doing, gal.
Your name is $name, right? I didn't expect a woman this time.
$name?... I don't recall you, how does a girl like you end up in the Zone?
Fresh from the real world, eh $name? Better get used to it, gal.
Feels good to join a girl who knows what she's doing, $name.
$name, right? I've heard that you are a girl not to mess with.
You know what? You're not too bad, $name. We could use more women like you in the Zone.
You're $name?! I heard a lot about your adventures back at our campfire last night. My friends said you're one of the few girls who survived a while in the Zone.
$name?! People say you're trustworthy. Lead the way, ma'am!
I've heard some of the stunts you've pulled off, $name. I've got to say - you have my respect, lady.
Oh, god! Can't believe I'm operating with $name!
People say you fucked up big time, $name. What have you done exactly, gal?
I'm not exactly sure why I'm following you around, $name. You're not the most trustworthy gal, I hear...
$name, you seem like a nice girl. Are you new around here?
Don't take this the wrong way, $name, but you're kind of a boring gal.
Lots of scary people around, $name. Are you a girl I can trust?
People say that you're a gal of your word, $name. I'm glad to join your team.
I know you're not like these other cunts around here, $name. They're all a bunch of backstabbers, I'm telling you.
